USE DOS
USE DOSCLIENT
USE PROGRAMFILE
USE PROGRAM
USE PROGRAMIMAGE
USE PROCESS
USE PROCESSSTATE
USE AESSTATE
USE AESCORE
USE O65CONTROL
USE O65TYPES
USE HEAPCORE
USE CSTRING.IMPL AS STR

CARD checks,completed
LONGCARD baseline
LONGINT lastPrimary,lastSecondary,expectedPrimary,expectedSecondary

PROC Require(BYTE okay)

  IF okay=0 THEN
    HEAPCORE.Abort($fb00+checks)
  FI

  checks==+1

RETURN

PUBLIC PROC Collected(LONGCARD id LONGINT expected)
  PROCESS.Result result

  Require(id<>0)
  Require(PROCESS.Wait(id,@result)<>0)
  lastPrimary=result.primary
  Require(result.primary=expected)
  completed==+1

RETURN

PUBLIC PROGRAMIMAGE.Image POINTER FUNC Load()
  BYTE ARRAY path(32)

  STR.strlcpy(path,c"SYS:PROBE.APP",SIZEOF(path))
  LET image=PROGRAMFILE.Load(path)
  STR.strlcpy(path,c"overwritten",SIZEOF(path))
  Require(image<>NULL)
  Require(image.kind=PROGRAMIMAGE.KIND_C)
  Require(STR.strcmp(CSTRING(@image.name(0)),c"PROBE.APP")=0)

RETURN(image)

PUBLIC LONGCARD FUNC Start(PROGRAMIMAGE.Image POINTER image BYTE POINTER args)

RETURN(PROCESS.StartLoaded(BYTE POINTER(image),args,1,0))

PROC Bad(BYTE POINTER name LONGINT error)

  Require(PROGRAMFILE.Load(name)=NULL)
  Require(DOS.IoErr()=error)
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)

RETURN

INCLUDE "runtime-observe.inc"
TYPE RuntimeReport=[CARD callbacks,order,writes,closes LONGCARD title,runs]
BYTE ARRAY quote=[34 0]
LONGCARD held

PROC Waited(PROGRAMIMAGE.Image POINTER image LONGCARD id LONGINT primary,secondary
    CARD callbacks,order,writes,closes LONGCARD runs)
  PROCESS.Result result

  Require(id<>0 AND PROCESS.Wait(id,@result)<>0)
  lastPrimary=result.primary
  lastSecondary=result.secondary
  expectedPrimary=primary
  expectedSecondary=secondary
  Require(result.primary=primary AND result.secondary=secondary)
  LET report=RuntimeReport POINTER(ADDRESS(LONGCARD(ADDRESS(image.text))+REPORT_OFFSET))
  Require(report.callbacks=callbacks AND report.order=order)
  Require(report.writes=writes AND report.closes=closes AND report.runs=runs)
  completed==+1

RETURN

PROC RunCase(PROGRAMIMAGE.Image POINTER image BYTE POINTER args LONGINT primary,secondary
    CARD callbacks,order,writes,closes LONGCARD runs)

  Waited(image,Start(image,args),primary,secondary,callbacks,order,writes,closes,runs)
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=held)

RETURN

  PROGRAMIMAGE.Image POINTER image,second
  LONGCARD one,two

  held=EXEC.AvailMem(0)
  RunCase(image,BYTE POINTER(c"R"),0,0,3,321,1,1,1)
  RunCase(image,BYTE POINTER(c"N"),-321,0,3,321,1,1,2)
  RunCase(image,BYTE POINTER(c"X"),7,0,0,0,0,1,3)
  RunCase(image,BYTE POINTER(c"C"),20,LONGINT(CARD(49689)),3,321,1,1,4)
  RunCase(image,BYTE POINTER(c"I"),20,103,3,321,1,1,4)
  RunCase(image,@quote(0),20,311,3,321,1,1,4)
  one=Start(image,BYTE POINTER(c"E"))
  Require(PROCESS.RequestStop(one)<>0)
  Waited(image,one,0,0,3,321,1,1,4)
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=held)
  RunCase(image,BYTE POINTER(c"R"),0,0,3,321,1,1,5)
  PROGRAM.Unload(image)
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  LET service=AESSTATE.Get()
  Require(service.count=0 AND AESCORE.Idle(service)<>0)
  DOS.SelectInput(oldInput)
  DOS.SelectOutput(oldOutput)
  Require(DOS.Close(input)<>0 AND DOS.Close(output)<>0)
  Require(DOS.ReleaseContext()<>0)

RETURN

ENDMODULE

      EXIT
    FI

    Require(DOS.Write(target,@resourceChunk(0),count)=count)
  OD
  Require(DOS.Close(source)<>0 AND DOS.Close(target)<>0)

RETURN

PROC RunApp(BYTE POINTER name)
  BYTE turn
  PROCESS.Result result

  currentApp==+1
  LET image=PROGRAMFILE.Load(name)
  Require(image<>NULL)
  LET child=PROCESS.StartLoaded(BYTE POINTER(image),BYTE POINTER(c""),0,0)
  Require(child<>0)
  FOR turn=0 TO 127 DO
    EXEC.Yield()
  OD

  LET service=AESSTATE.Get()
  Require(service.count=1 AND image.running<>0)
  Require(PROCESS.RequestStop(child)<>0)
  Require(PROCESS.Wait(child,@result)<>0)
  lastPrimary=result.primary
  Require(result.primary=0 AND result.secondary=0)
  PROGRAM.Unload(image)
  Require(service.count=0 AND AESCORE.Idle(service)<>0)
  completed==+1

RETURN

PROC Main()

  LET input=DOS.Open(BYTE POINTER(c"NIL:"),DOS.MODE_OLDFILE)
  LET output=DOS.Open(BYTE POINTER(c"NIL:"),DOS.MODE_NEWFILE)
  Require(input<>NULL AND output<>NULL)
  LET oldInput=DOS.SelectInput(input)
  LET oldOutput=DOS.SelectOutput(output)
  InstallResource()
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:PANEL.APP"))
  baseline=EXEC.AvailMem(0)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:PANEL.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:COUNTER.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:FILES.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:DESKTOP.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:DIALOG.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:CALC.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:G4BENCH.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:TEXT.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)
  RunApp(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:BASIC.APP"))
  Require(EXEC.AvailMem(0)=baseline)

  Bad(BYTE POINTER(c"SYS:OLD.APP"),LONGINT(O65TYPES.ERROR_BAD_FORMAT))
  DOS.SelectInput(oldInput)
  DOS.SelectOutput(oldOutput)
  Require(DOS.Close(input)<>0 AND DOS.Close(output)<>0)
  Require(DOS.ReleaseContext()<>0)

RETURN

ENDMODULE
